candidate.title: Moleculo
candidate.scope: The Illumina poster Moleculo product-preparation schematic only: already sheared ~10 kb genomic DNA undergoes end repair and adapter ligation, generation/amplification of clonal pools, three separately depicted tagmentation and indexing routes, then pooling/purification into short prepared DNA fragments. The three branches are clonal-pool instances of one named method, not alternative named assays. This is the depicted preparation architecture, not a claim about every Moleculo implementation. Sequencing and long-sequence reconstruction are outside the drawn workflow.

features: Biological target and input substrate are genomic DNA, depicted as a blue double-stranded fragment.
Shearing is input preparation history stated in the label, not a separately drawn operation.

operations.label: Tagmentation
operations.description: Acts on long amplified DNA in the left clonal-pool route. Under the transposase icons, the next row gains internal green and magenta segments; the following arrow isolates a short internal DNA fragment with those differently colored ends. operations.information_effect: The resulting library carrier contains a shorter genomic subsegment. Its former physical continuity with the rest of the ~10 kb template is no longer present in the isolated-fragment drawing.

method_scopes.rationale: The card title and sole figure title both identify Moleculo. All three clonal-pool routes lie under that one title and repeat the same transformation sequence. Shared captions are applied to separate tagmentation and indexing operation instances, while the actual branching distribution and final pooling stages retain multiple outputs/inputs. No other named target or alternative workflow is depicted. The supplied card has no publications or description beyond the name; the association is resolved at schematic scope, with no primary-paper implementation claim.

evidence.locator: Catalogue text in supplied source registry: Moleculo heading and repeated name (card description is also only Moleculo)
Whole composite panel: Moleculo title, common top preparation, three parallel clonal-pool routes and shared final prepared-fragment group

unknowns.question: What entity do the drawn Index 1/Index 2 sequences identify: a sample, a clonal pool, an individual original long molecule, or a combination? The diagram shows their positions and addition before pooling but no assignment or uniqueness rule. Resolving that association would require a matching implementation description or primary protocol explicitly defining these indices; it is not needed to retain the depicted preparation route.
